arguments.question: Assess ANET’s material geopolitical and policy channels over 5, 21 and 63 sessions: export controls affecting advanced-computing infrastructure, China/Macau applicability, tariffs/trade friction, geographic manufacturing/logistics exposure, and customer-order timing. Read the dated January 15, 2026 BIS rule and pertinent 2026 SEC filing passages; distinguish direct ANET exposure from second-order effects through customers or semiconductor availability, and do not treat a chip rule as automatically applicable to networking products. Identify whether any revenue is already excluded from guidance versus merely optional policy upside, quantify only disclosed exposure, and provide observable thesis-change conditions. Stop after the primary rule plus issuer disclosures; if product/geographic exposure is unquantified, state that limitation rather than infer it.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether policy or supply-chain events can materially alter the operating outlook or valuation cases, and prevents unsupported attribution of semiconductor export rules to ANET.
